messages:
ingrid: :rotating_light: Heads up — Saw a sudden cluster of 504/timeouts for a hosted customer (GreenBox) starting ~12:07UTC. Error breakdown: API gateway 504s and backend 5xx. p95 spiked to ~28s. Dashboard: https://dash.internal/redwood/hosted/requests?tenant=greenbox

jamie: +1 I see it. Request queue depth for the gateway host group jumped and continuous-batcher backlog length climbed steadily. Querying metrics now. Current snapshot: enqueue_depth_total=612, per_tenant_queue[greenbox]=520, cb_backlog=410, avg_batch_wait=220ms.

mohamed: Customer says their webhook retries are spiking and UX shows frequent timeouts. Raised a support ticket and pinged account team. Any quick mitigation we can do before deeper triage?

josh: Suggestion: temporarily lower continuous-batcher window and enable immediate dequeue for GreenBox to break the backlog. Also consider short-term per-tenant queue cap to avoid global saturation. I can roll the config patch to staging then to production if ops agrees.

ingrid: Good plan. jamie, can you paste the admin commands to inspect the batcher queue and the logs we should capture for postmortem?

jamie: Commands I ran:
```
# check batcher backlog via internal admin API
curl -sS "https://admin.internal/v1/batcher/backlog?host=hosted-gw-12" | jq '.'

# list tenant queue depths
curl -sS "https://admin.internal/v1/queues/tenants" | jq '."greenbox"'

# tail batcher logs quickly
kubectl logs -n inference batcher-hosted-12 -c batcher --since=10m | sed -n '1,200p'
```
Logs snippet (sanitized):
```
2026-03-18T12:06:52Z INFO  enqueue request tenant=greenbox req_id=abc123 depth=498
2026-03-18T12:07:01Z WARN  batcher.wait timeout=300ms queue_len=402
2026-03-18T12:07:10Z ERROR batcher.dispatch failure=req_timeout
2026-03-18T12:07:12Z ERROR gateway 504 request_id=abc123
```

josh: Ops steps I'd take (quick):
- apply per-tenant queue cap: `rwctl routing set-tenant-cap --tenant greenbox --cap 250`
- set continuous-batcher window to 50ms for hosted pool: `rwctl batcher set-window --pool hosted --window-ms 50`
- enable immediate-dequeue for tenant: `rwctl batcher set-dequeue-mode --tenant greenbox --mode immediate`

(These are quick rollbacks if they cause regressions.)

ingrid: jamie — can you check if other tenants are impacted? We need to know if GreenBox caused global backpressure or if some gateway host became a hotspot.

jamie: Quick sweep: other top tenants show healthy depths <120. Hotspot detected on hosted-gw-12 (CPU ~78%, net egress normal). Looks like uneven routing caused this host to absorb a disproportionate share for greenbox.

eng-runtime-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-3300001111, Severity: P2. Owner: eng-runtime. Playbook: continuous-batcher-backlog.

mohamed: Customer-facing update: "We're investigating increased timeouts for your requests and applying mitigation. Expect partial improvement in ~10-20m." Sent.

josh: I can apply the per-tenant cap and reduced window now as a canary on hosted-gw-12. Rolling change will be staged to 1 host first. Will post status.

ingrid: Approved. Tagging @jamie for monitoring after change. Also create a follow-up to add routing guardrail so a single tenant can't exceed X% of a host's queue.

jamie: Change applied to hosted-gw-12 canary at 12:09:40Z:
```
# applied tenant cap and batcher window
rwctl routing set-tenant-cap --tenant greenbox --cap 250 --target-host hosted-gw-12
rwctl batcher set-window --pool hosted --window-ms 50 --target-host hosted-gw-12
rwctl batcher set-dequeue-mode --tenant greenbox --mode immediate --target-host hosted-gw-12
```
Monitoring: per_tenant_queue[greenbox]=210 -> 180 over 5m, cb_backlog=410 -> 90, p95 latency -> 2.1s (from 28s).

mohamed: Customer notified: partial mitigation looks effective, monitoring for next 30m.

ingrid: Great. Postmortem action items: (1) add host-level tenant share guardrail, (2) improve routing to avoid single-host hotspots, (3) better alerting for enqueue_depth_total delta > 200 in 1m, (4) document rwctl steps in runbook. I'll open a follow-up issue.

josh: I'll also add a short-term dashboard widget for per-host tenant concentration.

support-bot: Ticket updated: SUPPORT-4821 status=investigating priority=high assigned=mohamed

ingrid: Closing the thread for now — continuing monitoring. Thanks everyone. :white_check_mark:
